posts.title: Office 6: room for a team of six
posts.caption:
Growing past the kitchen table?

A lot of Stellenbosch teams start the same way: a few people, a few home offices, and a WhatsApp group doing the job of a corridor. At some point the team needs one room.

We have a 6-seater private office open at The Village Hub in Nooitgedacht Village. It comes furnished, cleaned and connected: 24/7 secure access, dedicated Wi-Fi, printing credits, reception and free parking. When clients come in, you can book the Village Boardroom (12 seats) or the Village Chamber (10).

R20,950 a month, excluding 15% VAT. No fit-out.

If your team of four to six is ready for its own door, book a viewing: villagehub.co.za

posts.title: Meeting rooms open this fortnight
posts.caption:
